vb_textbox.text: The gnomes come in two sets. One set is red and green. The other set is purple and brown. One of each pair will give you more mushrooms than the other for a set period of time, then it will switch. If a gnome gives you less than 5 mushrooms a few times in a row, start choosing the other gnome.The maximum number of mushrooms you can get per turn is 9. If you're getting nines, you've got the right gnome colour.The important thing is to always choose a gnome. Getting one mushroom is better than getting nothing.Good luck =]
